title: Complex Mass Shells for Coloured quarks and their Asymptotic Confinement
summary: The present paper is the continuation of our previous work (R. Kerner and J. Lukierski, Nuclear Physics B, 2021) where we introduced a Z3-symmetric covering of the Lorentz group as a natural symmetry describing the quark fields. In the current version of QCD quarks are described by coloured triplets of standard Dirac fields. In contrast, we proposed to describe the colour triplets of quarks by entangled Z_3-graded Lee-Wick type fields, one with real mass and the two remaining ones with mutually conjugate complex masses.
